subject: SummitCloud marketplace onboarding — escalated support & SLA alignment
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@summitcloud.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace@summitcloud.io
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing stuck in review — urgent

Hi Soojin,

We noticed the Redwood Inference listing in the SummitCloud marketplace is stuck in "Under Review" for the last 48 hours. Our vendor onboarding dashboard is returning a 502 on the webhook verification step intermittently, and the manifest validation is failing with a YAML parsing error that only shows up on our side. This is blocking our joint beta customers from seeing the listing.

Can your integrations team take a look? I've attached the log snippet and the manifest we tried to push. If we can't get this cleared by EOD Tuesday our internal PM will ask to postpone the co-marketing launch.

Attachments: summit_log_snippet.txt (text), integration-manifest-v2.yaml (text)

Thanks,
Alex Park
Partnerships Lead — Marketplace Integrations
SummitCloud
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@summitcloud.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing stuck in review — urgent

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the files. Looping in Sergio (partner eng) and Lauren (sales lead) to triage.

Quick note on process: marketplace webhooks route through our private gateway in us-west and we had a deploy yesterday that changed header validation. I'll ask infra to confirm whether the 502s correlate with that deploy. In parallel Sergio, can you reproduce the YAML error against our validation service?

Plan:
- Sergio to QA manifest and run against staging validator (ETA 2 hours)
- Infrastructure to check gateway logs for 502 spike (ETA 1 hour)
- Lauren/Vanessa to prepare a short customer note in case we need to delay the launch (ETA 4 hours)

I'll drive status updates.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alex Park <alex.park@summitcloud.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing stuck in review — urgent

On Mon, Jun 15, 2026 at 10:08 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the heads up and the files. Looping in Sergio (partner eng) and Lauren (sales lead) to triage.

I ran the manifest through our staging validator and reproduced the parse failure. The root cause appears to be an edge-case: Summit's manifest includes a vendor-specific anchor that our YAML loader (libyaml v0.2.5) rejects when combined with a non-standard charset header from Summit's manifest generator. The parsing fails early which causes our validator to return a 400; Summit's system treats a 400 as a webhook failure and surfaces it as a 502 in their pipeline.

Immediate remediation: we can make our validator tolerant to that anchor by updating the loader configuration and adding a permissive charset fallback. I can prepare a hotfix and push it to a canary in us-west in ~3 hours. After that, Summit should be able to re-submit the manifest and proceed.

Risks & next steps:
- Hotfix will be targeted only at the marketplace-validator service and rolled out with a feature flag.
- We should monitor for any other vendor manifests that use the same anchor pattern. Sergio will add a regex-based detection to the validator logs.

Sergio
Principal Partner Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@summitcloud.io>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Action plan: validator hotfix + SLA compensation path

Alex — update from our end: Sergio pushed the permissive loader to canary in us-west and I validated a re-submission on Summit's staging pipeline this morning. The manifest accepted and the webhook completed without the 502.

Operational asks and SLA alignment we propose: 
1) Immediate: Summit can re-submit live manifest now; we'll prioritize verification and aim for green in 2 hours.
2) Short-term mitigation: If any customer-facing downtime occurred between Jun 14–15 we propose a joint incident note and a shared credit for affected listings (we estimate impact scope with Summit ops).
3) SLA adjustment: Because the issue surfaced from a manifest charset/loader mismatch during initial onboarding, we propose a partners-level exception to the standard 72-hour partner review SLA for this listing — move to a 24-hour privileged review window for the next 30 days while we monitor.

Can Summit confirm acceptance of the exception and whether they'd like Redwood to create the incident note and proposed credit calculation? If yes, Vanessa will lead the customer comms and Markus will review the credit signoff.

Thanks — circling back once we see the live verification.

— Soojin
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Park <alex.park@summitcloud.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace@summitcloud.io, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing stuck in review — urgent

Soojin / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan. Summit accepts the 24-hour privileged review for 30 days. Please proceed with the incident note and credit proposal. Our ops team also created Jira SUP-4521 to track follow-up items (I've added your team).

A couple of asks from Summit: 
- Can Redwood share the canary deployment ID and the change log for the validator hotfix? (our security team wants to audit the diffs)
- Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week (Mon/Tue preferred) to review monitoring thresholds and detection rules?

I'll watch for the incident note and the credit calculation. Appreciate the quick support — looking forward to the joint launch.

Best,
Alex Park
Partnerships Lead — Marketplace Integrations
SummitCloud
